    Happy April Fools' Day 2026! 🥳
     
    Hope your day is full of laughter and harmless tricks. As you navigate the day, keep an eye out for these 2026 shenanigans and deals: 
    • Free Coffee: Dunkin' is giving away 1 million free hot or iced coffees (excluding Cold Brew/XL hot) to start the morning.
    • Food Deals: Look for BOGO deals at Subway (using the app) and chances to win Chipotle codes.
    • Classic Pranks: Switch the "m" and "n" keys on a keyboard, add googly eyes to everything, or stick a note over a mouse sensor.
    • Digital Tricks: Watch out for "fake" news stories (like Pearl Jam's supposed Japanese re-recordings). 
    Remember: Trust no one today! 😉 Enjoy the foolishness!

    TheSimpsonsArt · Facebook
    Artist & writer
    April Fools’ Day, celebrated on April 1st, is a fun-filled day dedicated to pranks, jokes, and harmless tricks played on friends, family, and even the public. Its exact origin is unclear, but one popular theory links it to France’s switch to the Gregorian calendar in the 1500s, when people who continued celebrating the New Year around April were teased as “April fools.” Over time, the tradition spread worldwide, with each country adding its own twist, like sticking paper fish on people’s backs in France or limiting pranks to the morning in the UK. Today, even big companies and media outlets join in with playful hoaxes, but the key rule remains the same—keep it lighthearted, harmless, and fun for everyone.
